final: WITH phase_totals AS (SELECT s.phasefactor, SUM(e.imgcount) AS phase_total FROM scanenvironment AS e JOIN sites AS s ON e.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.phasefactor), overall_total AS (SELECT SUM(phase_total) AS total FROM phase_totals), phase_shares AS (SELECT p.phasefactor, p.phase_total, p.phase_total * 1.0 / o.total AS share FROM phase_totals AS p JOIN overall_total AS o ON o.total IS NOT NULL), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM phase_shares), kept AS (SELECT p.phase_total, p.share, p.share - a.avg_share AS share_difference FROM phase_shares AS p JOIN overall_average AS a ON a.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE p.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(phase_total) AS total_phase_images, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share_difference) AS average_share_difference FROM kept
